lead_raw_text:
The structure of LaZnC2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—two La, two Zn, and four C—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers with four geometric neighbors (one C and three La) at distances of 1.8922–2.3506 Å, while La centers coordinate to five C neighbors and Zn centers to five C neighbors at 2.1464–2.2463 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between C-centered 4-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between La- and Zn-centered 5-vertex polyhedra.
